title: Application of preceding sections to certain awards and testamentary directions to execute
text:
25. Application of preceding sections to certain awards and testamentary directions to execute

settlements.—The provisions of this Chapter as to contracts shall apply to awards to which [the Arbitration
and Conciliation Act, 1996 (26 of 1996)], does not apply and to directions in a will or codicil to execute a
particular settlement.

CHAPTER III

RECTIFICATION OF INSTRUMENTS
